---
description: Build incrementally (one slice at a time)
---

Implement one small, verifiable slice at a time using the skills in .github/skills.\n\nFor each slice:\n- Make the minimal code change\n- Run the most relevant checks\n- Report what changed and why\n\nAvoid unrelated refactors.\n\nIf the work is tracked in a markdown plan or todo file, update the completed task immediately after verification by changing [ ] task to [X] task.
